verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents support for product taxability differences across jurisdictions and offers AI-powered tax code recommendations from a product description, category, itemType or UPC. That shows its own tax-code taxonomy that catalog items can be mapped to. The pack does not show the category list, the per-line-item tax code field on CreateTransaction, or how codes vary by jurisdiction. missing for 10: documented tax-code taxonomy covering SaaS/digital goods/services/physical products, per-line-item tax code assignment in the transaction API, per-jurisdiction taxability detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can map my catalog to the vendor's tax categories — SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products — so each line item is taxed by what it is, in every jurisdiction it sells

citations.quote: Support scenarios such as product taxability differences, exemption logic, shipping rules, and temporary tax changes without building custom rule engines.

Provides AI-powered tax code recommendations for products. Returns 1 to 3 ranked tax code suggestions with confidence levels based on product description and optional inputs such as category, itemType, or UPC.
Global coverage. Access tax rates and rules for 200+ countries and jurisdictions
